data.description: Controls keyed by control ID. Shallow-merged by key — omitted keys are untouched; set to `null` to delete.

order.description: Display order for controls. When present, replaces the existing order.

config.description: Filter or interactive control config. Discriminated by `type`: filter types (string, date, number, etc.) or control types (FIELD_SELECTION, PERIOD_OVER_PERIOD, etc.). Visibility is determined by placement in the filter-bar container.

map.description: Per-tile field overrides keyed by tab ID. Values are a field name (override) or false (exclude tile from control).

filters.description: Child filters — each a simple filter or another composite filter. Recursive; see the dashboard-filters reference for the full grammar.

JsonValue.description: Arbitrary JSON value (string, number, boolean, null, object, or array).

data.description: Query presentations keyed by tab ID. Shallow-merged by key — omitted keys are untouched; set to `null` to delete. Capped at 48 entries per patch. When the request carries no `containers` and the document has a dashboard layout, dashboard-eligible tiles added at new keys are auto-placed on the dashboard's first page (non-renderable types such as CSV / dataset / query-view / dbt tabs are stored but not placed), and containers created by auto-placement are removed when their tile is deleted — containers placed via an explicit `containers` write are left in the layout. When `containers` is present it fully defines the layout; on a workbook-only document (no layout yet) tiles are stored without placement.

order.description: Tab display order. When present, replaces the existing order.

automaticVis.description: When true, the system automatically selects the best visualization type.

filterOrder.description: Ordered list of filter field names controlling display order on this tab.

isSql.description: Whether this tab is in raw SQL mode.

prefersChart.description: When true, the chart view is shown by default instead of the data table.

aiGenerated.description: True when AI generated this query’s SQL; the AI SQL is shown in the advanced SQL box.

allow_refs_to_unselected_fields.description: Set by the Kotlin parser when this calc references fields not selected at the top level (AI SQL-gen produces these; UI-authored calcs do not).

anchor_row.description: The 1-indexed row the Excel-style formula was authored against, so row-relative references resolve to the intended offsets — e.g. a percent-of-previous "=B4/B5" authored on row 5. Only used when sql_expression is omitted; defaults to 1 (B1 = this row).

calc_name.description: Internal identifier for the calculation, used as the column alias.

label.description: Display label shown in the UI.

original_formula.description: The calculation formula. Prefer referencing selected fields by name (e.g. "=SUM(orders.revenue)") — name references are stable under column reordering and have no row semantics. Excel-style references also work: column letters map to the query's fields in table order (A = the first field) with rows anchored at row 1 (set anchor_row to author row-relative references against a different row), and calc columns can only be referenced by letter. When sql_expression is omitted, the server parses this formula on write and rejects the request if it does not parse.

outside_pivot.description: When true, the calculation is evaluated outside the pivot grouping.

pushdown.description: Per-calc override for whether to evaluate before the row limit. `null` defers to the model-level default.

sql.description: Compiled SQL string produced from the formula.

sql_expression.description: Parsed SQL expression tree (serialized, server-internal format). Omit it to have the server parse original_formula instead.

swallow_errors.description: When true, calculation errors are silently swallowed instead of surfaced.

calculations.description: Table calculations attached to this query.

column_limit.description: Max number of pivot columns to return.

column_totals.description: Column-level aggregation totals, keyed by field name.

controls.description: Interactive controls (field selectors, PoP controls) attached to this query.

cube_metadata.description: Cube-specific metadata (topic name, cube name, hash key) for cube-backed queries.

custom_summary_types.description: Per-field custom summary functions (e.g. SUM, AVG, COUNT).

dbtFileName.description: dbt file name when this query is backed by a dbt model.

dbtMode.description: Whether this query is in dbt mode.

default_group_by.description: When true, all dimensions are implicitly included in GROUP BY, unless the model's default_group_by setting (never or primary_key) suppresses it.

dimensionIndex.description: Index of the primary dimension used for result ordering.

executableSQL.description: Server-compiled SQL string (read-only, set by the backend).

fields.description: Model field names selected for the query (dimensions + measures).

fill_fields.description: Fields whose missing date/time values should be filled with nulls to create continuous series.

filters.description: Query filters keyed by filter ID.

filtersUsedInSql.description: Filters that were embedded directly in raw SQL (read-only).

imported_model_ids.description: Model IDs (UUIDs) the query reaches through its composite topic's imports — the topic's import_models entries, which must be model ids, not names. Authorization requires the run gate on each; omit only for queries that do not touch imported topics.

join_paths_from_topic_name.description: Topic name that determines join path precedence for parsed SQL queries.

join_via_map.description: Virtual topic join path overrides, keyed by view name to ordered join path.

manualSort.description: When true, the user has explicitly set a custom sort order.

parsed.description: Whether this raw SQL query has been parsed into a semantic query.

periodOverPeriodTransposed.description: Whether the period-over-period comparison columns are transposed.

date_filter_field_name.description: The date dimension field this comparison is anchored to.

date_filter_id.description: ID of the date filter being offset (if backed by a dashboard filter).

is_dynamic_previous_period.description: When true, the previous period is calculated dynamically relative to the current filter range.

periods_ago.description: How many periods back to compare (e.g. 1 = previous period). Null if not set.

time_unit_name.description: Time grain for the offset (e.g. "month", "year"). Null if not set.

pivots.description: Field names to pivot on (columns become values).

rewriteSql.description: When true, the backend should rewrite/optimize the SQL.

row_totals.description: Row-level aggregation totals, keyed by field name.

column_name.description: The model field name to sort by.

is_column_sort.description: When true, this sort targets a pivoted column rather than a row dimension.

pivot_value_map.description: Maps pivot field names to specific pivot values, scoping the sort to a single pivot column.

sort_descending.description: When true, sort order is descending.

subtotal_sort.description: Field name whose subtotal row should be used as the sort key.

sorts.description: Sort clauses applied to the query result set.

sqlSortsEnabled.description: Whether user-created sorts are enabled on a raw SQL query.

staticQueryReferences.description: Pre-computed query references for AI chat context. Inner shape is `OmniQuery & { model_id: string }`; left as `unknown` to avoid a recursive zod schema. Validated structurally by consumers when they execute the referenced sub-queries.

table.description: Base view (table) name in the model.

transposed_measures.description: Measure field names that have been transposed into rows.

userEditedSQL.description: User-authored raw SQL (empty string when not in SQL mode).

query.description: The semantic query for this tab, minus the server-owned `modelId` anchor (the server anchors new/changed tiles to the draft; a FOREIGN tab keeps its stored execution model). `model_extension_id` is server-owned too — a supplied value is ignored and the tile keeps its existing binding (see the field’s own description). Omitted on a no-op replay.

resultConfig.description: Result display configuration (column widths, frozen columns, conditional formatting, number formatting, etc.).

topicName.description: The topic (explore) this query is built on.

type.description: The query presentation type (e.g. SEMANTIC, SQL, LINKED, SPREADSHEET). `foreign` is only valid when echoing an existing foreign tab at the same key — a tab cannot be created as, or converted to/from, FOREIGN through this API.

fields.description: Field names used in the visualization axes/series.

version.description: Schema version for vis config migration.

config.description: The vis-type-specific spec — KPI rows, chart mark/series, etc. GET nests the spec here; PATCH also accepts it spread flat next to visType for backward compatibility.

visConfig.description: Inner visualization config — structure varies by visType.

sourceQueryPresentationKey.description: For LINKED-type tabs, the record key — the same identifier used as a `queryPresentations.data` key — of the source tile whose query this tab reuses. Null for all other tab types. This is a tile record key, NOT a positional index into `order`.

crossfilterEnabled.description: When true, clicking a value in one tile filters all other tiles on the dashboard.

queryError.description: Custom text shown when a query errors, replacing the default error text.

queryNoResults.description: Custom text shown when a query returns no results, replacing the default empty state.

customText.description: Custom text replacing default UI strings on the dashboard, e.g. when queries error or return no results.

facetFilters.description: When true, dashboard filters are applied per-facet when faceting is active.

refreshInterval.description: Auto-refresh interval in seconds. Null disables auto-refresh.

runQueriesOn.description: Controls whether dashboard queries execute on the visible page or across all pages.

SettingsPatchExternal.description: Document settings. Shallow-merged with the existing settings.

DocumentsV2AppEcho.description: Accepted so a GET of an app document round-trips through PATCH; nothing in it is written. A `url` that does not address this document's app is rejected with 409. App content and settings are written only at the app sub-resource routes (`PUT` / `PATCH …/draft/app` or `…/draft/{draftIdentifier}/app`).
